# state produce

## GHZ

本质上需要 H 和一些 CNOT; 特殊的地方加Z或X修一下结果就可以了

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
import numpy as np
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

# save statevector
qc = QuantumCircuit(4, 4)
qc.h([0])
qc.cx([i for i in range(3)], [i for i in range(1, 4)])
qc.z([0])
qc.x([2 * i for i in range(2)])
qc.draw()
qc.save_statevector() 
```

```python
sim = AerSimulator(
    method="statevector",
    device="CPU",     
    precision="single",
)
tqc = transpile(qc, sim)
job = sim.run(
    tqc,
)
vec_result = job.result()
psi = vec_result.get_statevector()  # |0101⟩ - |1010⟩
print(psi)
```
